notes.title: Spaceman 50% OFF! + Major Update Near!
notes.content:
Hello there,

That's right. Spaceman is having a 50% OFF promotional price this week!

Also, this is also to announce that a Major Update will be released in the next 1 or 2 weeks, with a completely remodeling of Spaceman (sprites and tilesets) and new features to this adventure. 

Enjoy!

notes.title: Spaceman Major Update + MacOS support!
notes.content:
[h1]SPACEMAN UPDATE!
[/h1]

Hello,
We would like to announce that Spaceman is now updated and have MacOS support.

[b]Update features:
[/b][i]- Artificial Intelligence added to some of the enemies;
- UI redesigned;
- Map design update;
- Mac OS support.[/i]

Check the new trailer and screenshots for a sneak peek! 

[b]Conmtrast[/b]
